name: Amazon
note: Official sponsor and retail partner of the U.S. SailGP Team (ussailgpteam.com, 2 Jun 2025). Left unrated for a maintainer: the owner is sourced (amazon-com-inc-listing: Amazon.com, Inc. is Nasdaq-listed; no state or state-fund holder found), but the company test isn't settled. Amnesty International's report 'Don't worry, it's a branch of Amazon' (2023-10-10, https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/mde23/7229/2023/en/) documents abuses of Nepali migrant workers contracted to Amazon's warehouses in Saudi Arabia between 2021 and 2023 and says many 'are highly likely to be victims of human trafficking'; Amnesty's release of the same day (https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2023/10/saudi-arabia-migrants-workers-who-toiled-in-amazon-warehouses-were-deceived-and-exploited/) says Amazon 'has contributed to abuses'. The US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission issued determinations in February and April 2026 that Amazon systemically violated the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act and the Americans with Disabilities Act in its warehouses, as reported by the workers' counsel A Better Balance (2026-04-24, https://www.abetterbalance.org/federal-agency-finds-amazon-is-systemically-violating-disabled-workers-rights/); the determinations themselves weren't opened. OSHA's ergonomics citations from inspections at ten Amazon warehouses that began in 2022 ended in a corporate-wide settlement (OSHA, 2024-12-19, https://www.osha.gov/news/newsreleases/osha-national-news-release/20241219), which by itself isn't a finding. No record claim is written yet.
